effect_description_eng: ＜Iceclad＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Blocker＞ [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards from your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, 1 of your [Ice-Snow] trait Digimon may attack without suspending. [When Attacking] You may return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.

option.effect_text: [Main] Trash all cards from under 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 2 of their Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until their turn ends.
